audit_items.proof_trace: Two bypass paths exist: (1) bad-debt bypass at L984-992 returns early when collateral_total_value <= 1.01 * debts_total_value — explicitly commented as intentional protocol protection against bad-debt accumulation; (2) min-value bypass at L1006 skips close_factor when debt_value (USD value of the specific DebtType in the obligation) <= close_factor_bypass_min_value. Both are clearly documented design choices; the bad-debt bypass can trigger on large positions near insolvency, but this is standard DeFi protection and is not exploitable by an external attacker.
